text: The three flagship projects share a lot of groundwork, but each one leans on a different skill set. This lesson gives you a simple way to decide which one to polish deepest.

The DeFi protocol leans on AMM math and economic security. The NFT marketplace leans on escrow patterns, indexing, and marketplace UX. The DAO leans on governance design — voting weight, quorum, and treasury timelocks.

Ask what role you're targeting. A protocol or smart-contract engineering role points you toward the DeFi protocol. A full-stack Web3 role points toward the NFT marketplace. A security or governance-leaning role points toward the DAO.

Choosing an emphasis doesn't mean skipping the other two. This course builds the DeFi protocol first either way, because its testing and deployment patterns get reused — emphasis just decides which project gets the extra polish pass before you show it to an employer.
